en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European street along a landscaped promenade or small park. On the left is a row of 2–3 story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, shutters, and climbing plants on the façades. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the cobbled street. On the right is a tree‑lined path and planted area with low fences and benches. A vertical column or monument is faintly visible among the trees in the background. One building on the left has a commercial signboard.
